_meta.description: Illustration provenance manifest. Each entry binds a deterministic asset (TikZ / SVG / matplotlib redraw) to a source LaTeX block via cryptographic hashes. Image generation models MAY be used during draft exploration; the final asset is the deterministic redraw that the certificate trusts. Edits to the source block invalidate the asset's certificate until the asset is re-authored and re-certified.
_meta.claim_scope_default: schematic illustration only; not empirical evidence
_meta.design: Source LaTeX block --hash--> manifest_source_hash. Final asset --hash--> manifest_asset_hash. Optional visual_spec markdown --hash--> manifest_spec_hash. Layer 14 (illustration_lineage_check.py) verifies all three.
